addr: 4th Floor, Cult, EVA Mall, 157, Brigade Rd, Shanthala Nagar, Ashok Nagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560025, India

rev.t: Been going to Cult for the last 5 months and the experience has been absolutely fantastic! The fitness center is super well-equipped and has an amazing vibe. …
They refuse to turn on AC. Have discussed with customer care over hello cult fit and they said it's fixed after taking a month but no change.

I had opted for dance class here. The instructor was performing filmy steps, no energy. There is no parking, we have to pay for the parking. What sort of cult centre doesn't have parking ? Over all not going to this cult centre anymore. Very disappointed.
